newsitem.title: USA: Princeton Media Group Inc Q1 full results.
newsitem.headline: Princeton Media Group Inc Q1 full results.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: The company said there were no earnings comparisons for the first quarter of 1996 because that was prior to the company's acquisition of two publishing businesses.

The company said that the loss per share, after cumulative preferred dividends which are being liquidated as part of the company's settlements with convertible securities holders, together with non-cash deemed dividends attributed to the preferred holdings, is $0.46.
